system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: A process named pfupdater.exe ran from the user's AppData\Roaming\PixelForge directory, rather than the approved updater location under Program Files. It ran as leo.martins at medium integrity.

The process made repeated proxy-mediated HTTPS CONNECT attempts to updates.pixelforge-suite.co, while the approved PixelForge update host in the inventory is updates.pixelforge-suite.com. The observed hostname differs from the approved hostname.

The repeated connections occurred at roughly five-minute intervals and were associated with the AppData pfupdater.exe process; several proxy records report a Firefox user agent despite that process identity.
Some attempts to the differing hostname were allowed as tunnels, while others received a gateway error or were denied; the allowed records include recurring, similar byte counts.

The combination of an updater-like process running from an unexpected user-writable location, a destination differing from the approved update hostname, and recurring connections with a mismatched user agent supports treating this activity as malicious rather than as the approved PixelForge updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records describe CONNECT tunnels and byte counts, not the encrypted HTTPS contents or actions performed after the tunnel was established (for example, T055-00149 and T055-00152).
The supplied records do not show a DNS query or resolved IP address for updates.pixelforge-suite.co.
The available process records do not establish the executable's signature, hash, provenance, or whether it was modified.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what data, if any, was sent to or received from the destination.
The evidence does not establish who installed or launched the AppData pfupdater.exe, or whether it is definitively malware.
The evidence does not establish the destination domain's ownership, reputation, or relationship to PixelForge.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and analyze the pfupdater.exe file, including its hash, digital signature, file metadata, and provenance.
Obtain DNS resolver and proxy/TLS inspection records for updates.pixelforge-suite.co, plus domain and certificate registration or reputation information.
Collect endpoint file, persistence, and execution-history evidence to determine how the executable arrived and whether it changed other files or established persistence.
Review proxy or endpoint telemetry for the content and purpose of the recurring connections, including any data transfer beyond the recorded tunnel byte counts.
